name: liongard-mcp
description: Every Liongard endpoint, plus an offline copy of your whole MSP estate you can join, search, and drift-check from one command.

liongard_access_key_id.title: Liongard Access Key ID
liongard_access_key_id.description: Liongard Access Key ID, the half that pairs with LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET; the server composes the two into the base64 X-ROAR-API-KEY. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this pair OR the pre-encoded LIONGARD_API_KEY, never both. LIONGARD_API_KEY wins when it is set, so leave it blank to use this pair.

liongard_access_key_secret.title: Liongard Access Key Secret
liongard_access_key_secret.description: Liongard Access Key Secret, the other half of LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this pair OR the pre-encoded LIONGARD_API_KEY, never both. LIONGARD_API_KEY wins when it is set, so leave it blank to use this pair.

liongard_api_key.title: LIONGARD_API_KEY
liongard_api_key.description: Pre-encoded X-ROAR-API-KEY: base64 of 'accessKeyId:accessKeySecret'. One of two ways to authenticate - set EITHER this key OR the LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_ID + LIONGARD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET pair, never both. This key wins when it is set, and the pair is ignored.

liongard_endpoints_session_token_auth.title: LIONGARD_ENDPOINTS_SESSION_TOKEN_AUTH
liongard_endpoints_session_token_auth.description: Optional Liongard session token (from `authentication log-in`), sent as X-Auth-Token only to the endpoints that accept a session token (verify-token, access-key create). Leave blank to use the access key.

liongard_instance.title: LIONGARD_INSTANCE
liongard_instance.description: Sets LIONGARD_INSTANCE for the endpoint template variable {instance}.

liongard_base_url.title: Liongard API base URL
liongard_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from LIONGARD_INSTANCE. Set it only to point at a different host.

liongard_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
liongard_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

liongard_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
liongard_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

liongard_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
liongard_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses; leave blank.

liongard_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
liongard_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Liongard requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
